identity.tagline: I build LLM systems that run in production — with human approval gates, fact-checking, and the boring operational plumbing that keeps them honest.

profile: AI & Automation Engineer and founder of Streamlite Technologies, building LLM systems that run in production for clients in Canada, the US and Mexico: integrations with APIs that fight back, human approval gates so nothing publishes unreviewed, and the operational plumbing that keeps both honest.

Six years of data analytics underneath — Power BI, DAX, SQL — which is why I care what a number means before I automate it. Before that, a decade of systems work in Mexico: software engineering, SAP ABAP, web applications and end-user support.

I own the whole line: discovery with the client, architecture, build, deploy, and the 2 a.m. alert. Bilingual in Spanish and English. Open to AI / Automation Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer roles.

experience.summary: AI automation consultancy for small and mid-size businesses across Canada, the US and Mexico. Sole engineer on every engagement: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, billing and on-call.
bullets: Built and run GBP Manager, a multi-tenant LLM SaaS for Google Business Profiles; nothing publishes without a per-item human approval record. Google API production access approved after two rejections.
Automated Canadian immigration (IRCC) PDF forms from one canonical schema using Claude tool use and XFA XML; in production for an immigration consultancy.
Delivered ScopeForge, a bid-intelligence platform for a millwork subcontractor: AI scope extraction from bid packages, BuildingConnected sync, DOCX proposals and an automated 3-step follow-up.
Own a ~30M-row Power BI model and a PLD/AML transactional monitoring layer (fraud detectors, per-merchant thresholds, audited retention) for a Mexican POS distributor.
Shipped Relay, social and local-SEO automation on the Meta Graph API at Standard Access, deployed per client on isolated branches; one paying client.
Built a Microsoft licence drift detector as a paid-evaluation prototype for an MSP: 100% recall, zero false positives on a ground-truth set.
Implemented and maintained the CRM system (Pipedrive), ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Led website functionality updates and content management for immigration programs and services.
Developed landing pages to optimize lead generation and conversion.
Analyzed data to generate Power BI reports and insights for decision-making on immigration client needs.
Designed and developed Power BI dashboards on sales performance and customer behaviour for the retail industry.
Implemented advanced data visualizations in Power BI for comprehensive analysis.
Ran training sessions on effective use of Power BI for the data analytics team.
Wrote and optimized SQL statements for more efficient data analysis.
Designed customized data collection models for visualization tasks.
Created data analysis tools for easy querying and insight generation.
Implemented advanced data visualizations in Power BI dashboards.

experience.summary: Part-time engagement with the POS distributor that re-engaged Streamlite in 2025 for its BI and PLD/AML stack (see above).
bullets: Implemented ActiveCampaign as the CRM and trained employees on it for improved data management.
